verdict.rationale: A tax-compliance portal could plausibly offer scheduled or autonomous background tasks such as recurring filings or payments, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows manual, user-driven workflows (registration, filing returns, challan payment, the offline invoice upload tool) and a developer API portal landing page. None of these documents user-configurable automations that run in the background; APIs and offline tools are at most developer building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
